description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.
The ID of the network ACL.

description.zh:
网络ACL所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the network ACL.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

title.en: Query details of a network ACL

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-network-acl-attributes --network-acl-id nacl-a2do9e413e0spzasx0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
